note: Decision tree of fid_loop.py. change = patch of the job config (merged into the parent's config). pass = next node if the FID beats the control by more than the margin (the change is kept), fail = next node if not (the change is dropped). No node adds a model parameter. follower_only = the node runs only when another node names it. A null follower = the first node of this file that has not run.

teacher_clean.why: The teacher sees the clean image, not the image at the lower noise level: a target without noise, as in JEPA

mask_student.why: Masked student on top of the clean teacher: the noisier patches are pure noise, the I-JEPA setup

pairs_three.why: Teaching at three depths: blocks 2, 3 and 4 learn from blocks 5, 6 and 7

pair_deep_target.why: One pair with the deepest target: block 3 learns from block 8, after three pairs failed

ctx_half.why: SGF+ idea without new parameters: half the denoising loss on the cleaner (context) patches, so they serve the noisier patches more

ctx_zero.why: No denoising loss on the context patches: they learn only through the noisier patches and the teaching term (SGF+ in full)

ctx_double.why: Twice the denoising loss on the context patches: the opposite direction, after one half failed

ema_teacher.why: Winner of the Spark loop (124.39 against 126.42), repeated on this machine: teacher pass with averaged weights, decay 0.999

no_selfflow.why: Sensitivity test: self-flow off (plain training, as the control run without teaching). If the FID does not rise, 16,000 steps cannot show the value of self-flow

teach_weight_half.why: Teaching term at weight 0.5: the best of the weight tests on the Spark (124.31 against 124.39), repeated here

out_align_1.why: View alignment at the output with weight 1: the student's final image is also pulled to the averaged teacher's final image (the Spark tests weight 0.5)

readouts_double.why: Double weight on the readout losses: second lowest FID of the Spark loop (124.23 against 124.39), repeated here to see if the small gain is real

teach_half_noisy.why: Teaching weight 0.5 on the noisier patches only: lowest FID of the Spark loop (124.21 against 124.39), repeated here to see if the small gain is real
